_meta.source: Narutopedia (naruto.fandom.com) via MediaWiki API (infobox species/nature/jutsu/height/debut) + series knowledge; generic templates and 'inspired' entries are game-original extrapolations clearly marked.
_meta.compat: tailed_beasts keep tails/animal/element_or_ability/game_suggestion; summons keep animal/home/traits from clans_factions.json
_meta.size_notes: Canon heights only from Narutopedia infoboxes: Gamabunta 17 m, Gamaken/Gamahiro 19 m, Gamakichi 16.9 m (Part II), Fukasaku 0.253 m, Shima 0.25 m, Ninja tortoise 0.9 m. Tailed beast heights are not given in databooks; values are scene-based estimates (Kurama ~ Hokage Rock; Gamabunta reaches its torso; Gyūki matches the Giant Squid; Gedō Mazō taller than tailed beasts — Gyūki reaches its chin).

cloak_stages: 2: Version 2 (skin-like dark cloak, more tails, host takes damage)
Cooperation: Tailed Beast Mode / chakra avatar with stable control
rules: Each extra tail = more power but faster HP drain unless cooperating
Sealing marks on host stomach; seal-breaking = beast escape
Extracting a beast kills the host (lore)
Hosts historically assigned per village: Suna(1), Kumo(2,8), Kiri(3,6), Iwa(4,5), Taki(7), Konoha(9)

_meta.notes: Named canon individuals are kept as signature:true references; generic species templates are the core usable entries. Original-characters-only rule: no canon person is a player-facing NPC.

tailed_beasts.name: Shukaku (Kum Muhafızı / Bir Kuyruk)
abilities: Wind Release: Drilling Air Bullet (compressed air shot from belly-drum)
Desert Layered Imperial Funeral Seal (sealing jutsu)
Forces sleeping host to lose control (takes over when host sleeps)
tailed_beasts.behavior: Hyperaktif, alaycı, kana susamış; kibirli ve diğer kuyruklu canavarlara (özellikle Kurama'ya) karşı rekabetçi. Uzun süre zincirli kaldığından insanlara güvenmez.
tailed_beasts.visual: Upright pot-bellied tanuki, short stubby legs, long thick single tail. Sandy-brown/tan body covered in dark blue-black cursed-seal-like markings (wavy bands, dots, spirals) over face, body and tail. Jagged concave toothy mouth, no tongue. Eyes: black sclera, yellow iris, black four-pointed star pupil with four black dots around it. Sand constantly streams/crumbles off its surface; can be partially formed (arm/tail only).
tailed_beasts.desc: Çöl bölgesi bossu. Kum zırhı kırılınca 2. faz; alnındaki/başındaki konakçı (ya da mühür noktası) zayıf nokta. Arena: bataklık kumu ve kum fırtınası. Rüzgar mermileri uzak menzil baskı yapar.
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: wind; earth; magnet; Sand manipulation and sand armor; Wind Release: Drilling Air Bullet (compressed air shot from belly-drum); Wind Release: Sand Buckshot
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).

cloak_stages: Sand armor creeping over host's skin (partial)
Full transformation: host buried at forehead, sleep technique releases full beast
jinchuriki_mechanics.partial: Sand limbs, automatic Shield of Sand-like defense
jinchuriki_mechanics.full: Full sand tanuki with host embedded in forehead; waking host ends transformation

tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Desert boss with huge hitbox; quicksand hazards; weak point on forehead; phase 2 when sand armor breaks.

tailed_beasts.name: Matatabi (Kedi Nanesi / İki Kuyruk)
abilities: Pounce and high agility for size
tailed_beasts.behavior: Kibar, sakin ve nazik konuşan; kuyruklu canavarlar arasında en uysal olanlardan. Saygı görürse işbirliğine açık.
tailed_beasts.visual: Huge feline quadruped entirely engulfed in animated cobalt-blue and black flames (no solid fur visible). Two long flaming tails. Heterochromatic pupil-less eyes: right yellow, left green. Pointed ears, fanged mouth. Flames flicker upward like a kasha spirit.
tailed_beasts.desc: Hızlı, sıçrayan boss: pençe saldırıları ve mavi alev zemin yakması. Su elementi saldırıları ekstra hasar verir; alevi söndürmek savunmasını düşürür.
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: fire; Blue/black spirit flames (body is fire); Cat Flame Roaring Fire (fireballs); Great Cat Claw Attack
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Agile flaming cat boss; burning ground zones; water jutsu strip flame armor.

tailed_beasts.name: Isobu (Kıyı Okşayan / Üç Kuyruk)
abilities: Coral Palm (coral grows over target to imprison)
Shell Tower / Leaping Bullet (spinning shell ram)
Water Release: Great Water Mass Bullet
tailed_beasts.behavior: Çekingen, utangaç ve korkak; ama tehdit altında çok sert savunur. Su altında saklanmayı sever.
tailed_beasts.visual: Massive turtle with spiky crab-like shell (grey-green), spikes over whole body and on large forehead and lower jaw. Three long shrimp-like segmented tails. Pair of human-like arms with hands, no hind legs. Red muscle-like tissue visible under shell. Face hidden between forehead plate and jaw. Red eyes with crimson (or yellow) pupils; right eye always closed (single open eye).
tailed_beasts.desc: Göl/deniz bossu. Mercan pençesi oyuncuyu kristalleştirir (QTE ile kır). Kabuk dönüş saldırısı. Zayıf nokta: açık tek göz ve kabuk altındaki kırmızı doku.
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: water; yin(anime); Coral Palm (coral grows over target to imprison); Shell Tower / Leaping Bullet (spinning shell ram); Illusionary Mist (genjutsu fog, anime)
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Lake/sea boss; coral prison mechanic; shell-spin charge; hit the open eye.

tailed_beasts.name: Son Gokū (Göğe Eş Büyük Bilge / Dört Kuyruk)
tailed_beasts.behavior: Gururlu, inatçı, ateşli mizaçlı; adıyla hitap edilmeyi ve saygı görmeyi talep eder. Savaşçı onuruna önem verir.
tailed_beasts.visual: Gorilla-build monkey with red fur and green skin (face, chest, hands). Two long upward-curving horns on forehead like a crown, elongated blunt fangs; horns and fangs dark-tipped. Yellow irises with white pupils. Four tails with spike-like protrusions along their length. Tongueless mouth with a dome-volcano-shaped opening (lava spews from it).
tailed_beasts.desc: Volkanik bölge bossu. Lav havuzları arena tehlikesi; tutma (grab) saldırısı. Su ve rüzgar zayıflığı yok, toprak/lav dirençli.
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: fire; earth; lava; Lava Release: spits lava/magma bombs; Flower–Fruit Mountain (lava bomb barrage); Monkey Flame Arson (anime)
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Volcano boss with lava pools and magma bomb volleys.

tailed_beasts.name: Kokuō (Bilge Kral / Beş Kuyruk)
tailed_beasts.behavior: Sakin, mesafeli, kendini beğenmiş ama nazik. Güveni kazanılırsa bilge bir danışman gibi konuşur.
tailed_beasts.visual: White horse body with a dolphin head. Two long pointed horns plus three shorter horns in front. Horn ends, hooves and five bushy tails are tan, with tan spots before the tips. Red markings under dark blue-green eyes. Steam venting from body.
tailed_beasts.desc: Kaplıca/buhar bölgesi bossu. Buhar zırhı yakın dövüşte yanma DoT'u verir; boynuz hücumundan kaçmak için parkur gerekir.
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: fire; water; boil; Boil Release: Unrivalled Strength (steam-boosted power); Steam armor/vents (boiling steam damages attackers); Horn Breaking (devastating horn charge)
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Steam-armored charger; melee attackers take scald damage.

tailed_beasts.name: Saiken (Gergedan Köpek / Altı Kuyruk)
abilities: Leech Gap / Wisdom Wolf Decay (corrosive gas)
Water Release: Starch Syrup Capturing Field (sticky)
tailed_beasts.behavior: Neşeli, kibar ve iyi niyetli; kuyruklu canavarlar içinde en dost canlısı. Konuşmaları nazik.
tailed_beasts.visual: Enormous white bipedal slug with a light bluish tint, stubby arms and feet, six long tails. Two prominent eye-stalk optical tentacles, hole-like opening as mouth. Body covered in thick glistening slime.
tailed_beasts.desc: Bataklık bossu. Aşındırıcı balçık zırh dayanıklılığını azaltır; yapışkan alan hareketi yavaşlatır. Ateş/rüzgar ile balçığı kurutmak hasar penceresi açar.
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: water; Corrosive alkaline mucus; Leech Gap / Wisdom Wolf Decay (corrosive gas); Water Release: Starch Syrup Capturing Field (sticky)
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Swamp boss with gear-corroding slime and sticky slow fields.

tailed_beasts.name: Chōmei (Şanslı Yedi / Yedi Kuyruk)
tailed_beasts.behavior: Neşeli, iyimser; kendini şanslı sayar. Özgürlüğü ve uçmayı sever.
tailed_beasts.visual: Blue armored rhinoceros beetle. Seven tails from abdomen: six look like green-stemmed orange insect wings, one is an actual tail. Helmet-like skull covers eyes with orange glow inside. Spiked shoulders with rows of slits, six blue-armored legs with green tips, three-part face pincers over sharp teeth, large two-section horn on back behind head. (Larval stage: all green grub.)
tailed_beasts.desc: Hava bossu: arenada uçar, pullu tozla görüşü kapatır. Duvar koşusu/parkur ile platformlardan atlayarak sırtına inme mekaniği.
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: wind(implied); Flight with six insect-wing tails; Glittering scale powder (blinds); Bug Bite / spear horn charge
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Flying boss; scale powder blinds; parkur up to mount its back.

tailed_beasts.name: Gyūki (Öküz İblis / Sekiz Kuyruk)
abilities: Ink spray (blinds, can be used to escape)
Tentacle grapples and severable tentacle clones
tailed_beasts.behavior: Ciddi, mantıklı, sabırlı; konakçısıyla dostluk kurabilen nadir canavar. Şakalara/kafiyelere karşı sinirli ama sevgi dolu.
tailed_beasts.visual: Muscular hunched bison-like upper body with humanoid arms (spiked elbows, opposable thumbs), four long Jacob-sheep-style curling horns, straight teeth. Lower half is eight octopus tentacles instead of legs. Dark reddish-brown/grey-purple skin, horns lighter; often shown with chipped horn/tooth.
tailed_beasts.desc: Denizkıyısı/kayalık bossu; mürekkep görüşü kısıtlar. Kopartılan dokunaçlar küçük düşmanlara dönüşür (minion). Kumogakure arka planlı görev hattı.
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: Ink spray (blinds, can be used to escape); Tentacle grapples and severable tentacle clones; Tailed Beast Ball (continuous)
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).

jinchuriki_mechanics.full: Full Eight-Tails; can partially transform (tentacles only) at will in perfect control

tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: Tentacle boss; severed tentacles spawn adds; ink blinds.

tailed_beasts.name: Kurama (Karanlık Kanatlı / Dokuz Kuyruk)
abilities: Tailed Beast Ball / Continuous Tailed Beast Balls
tailed_beasts.behavior: En güçlü kuyruklu canavar; gururlu, alaycı ve öfkeli; insanlardan nefret eder ama dostluk kazanılırsa sadık ve koruyucu olur.
tailed_beasts.visual: Red-orange fox with black fur around red slit-pupil eyes extending up to the ears. Nine long sweeping tails. Humanoid upper body with opposable clawed hands; long jaw full of fangs. Large enough that a 17 m boss toad only reaches its torso; comparable to the Hokage Rock.
tailed_beasts.desc: Final düzey boss / hikaye bossu (köy saldırısı olayı). Tam faz: arena ölçekli kuyruk savuruşları; mühürleme mini-oyunu. Kanon konakçı kullanılmaz; köy tarihi Konoha olarak anılabilir.
tailed_beasts.element_or_ability: fire(anime); wind(anime); Negative Emotion Sensing; Massive chakra reserves and regeneration; Tailed Beast Ball / Continuous Tailed Beast Balls
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).

tailed_beasts.name: Jūbi (On Kuyruk) – Eksik İlk Form
tailed_beasts.behavior: Düşünce yok; saf yıkım içgüdüsü. Kaybolan parçaları (diğer kuyruklu canavarlar) toplamaya çalışır.
tailed_beasts.visual: Grotesque brown bulb-like body with long arms and clawed hands, no visible hind legs. Single huge eye (ringed Rinne-Sharingan-like, red with ripples and tomoe) covering most of head. Wide mouth with multiple rows of pointed teeth, single chin spike. Conch-shell spikes on back, dark veins; ten tails like gnarled tree roots.
tailed_beasts.desc: Mega-boss faz 1. Bölünme saldırısıyla küçük klonlar çağırır. Yalnızca dünya-olayı/raid formatında.
tailed_beasts.animal: Godlike chimera of the God Tree
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).
tailed_beasts.game_suggestion: World-event raid boss; spawns fission clones; multi-phase.

tailed_beasts.name: Jūbi – İkinci Form
abilities: Wood Release: Cutting Technique (wooden spike blades)
tailed_beasts.behavior: Kendini gerçek formuna yaklaştırmış; daha bilinçli ve saldırgan.
tailed_beasts.visual: Taller, more muscular humanoid-beast stance with long arms; brown hide, single ringed eye; ten writhing tails; larger back spikes like a conch.
tailed_beasts.desc: Raid boss faz 2: doğal afet çağrısı (yıldırım/meteor/hortum) arena çapında.
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).

tailed_beasts.name: Jūbi – Ağaç Formu (Shinju)
abilities: Roots drain chakra from all life
Flower blooms to cast Infinite Tsukuyomi
tailed_beasts.behavior: Bitkisel; pasif-saldırgan. Kökleri hayat enerjisini emer.
tailed_beasts.visual: Colossal tree with trunk of twisting roots, giant flower bud with single ringed eye at the top; roots spread across the landscape with pod-like cocoons.
tailed_beasts.desc: Final arena: ağaç gövdesine tırmanma (parkur) ve köklerin enerji emme alanından kaçış.
tailed_beasts.size_note: Databook vermez; sahnelerden tahmin (Gamabunta 17 m referans).

tailed_beasts.name: Jūbi Bölünme Klonu
tailed_beasts.behavior: Akılsız sürü; ana bedenden kopar, yakındaki her şeye saldırır.
tailed_beasts.visual: Small to medium monstrous clones: grey-white rubbery skin, single big eye, large toothy mouth, stubby limbs; some look like misshapen apes, some like tadpoles.
tailed_beasts.desc: Raid sırasında dalgalar halinde gelen sıradan düşman; alan hasarına zayıf.

artificial_humans.behavior: Neşeli, çocuksu, gevezedir; ama emre uyan sürü.
artificial_humans.visual: Bald pale white humanoid with smooth plant-like skin, round eyes with black pupils, wide grin; some have flytrap leaf collars. Naked or minimal clothing.
artificial_humans.desc: Ordu dalgası düşmanı; kimliği taklit eden casus mekaniği (dost NPC aslında Zetsu olabilir).

artificial_humans.name: Sızmacı Ak Zetsu
artificial_humans.visual: Identical to a shinobi except subtle tell (smell of plant, green sap when cut).

artificial_humans.name: Spor Klonu
abilities: Latches onto host, grows from body, drains chakra
artificial_humans.visual: Small white pod/bud that sprouts on target and grows into a humanoid.

artificial_humans.name: Sarmal Zetsu (Guruguru tipi)
abilities: Armor that wraps around host body
artificial_humans.visual: Pale humanoid with spiral-patterned face and body, single eyehole.

artificial_humans.name: Kara Zetsu (Gölge İradesi)
abilities: Possesses and controls a host body
artificial_humans.visual: Pure black humanoid of tar-like flesh with yellow-white eyes; can wrap as a skin over a host.
artificial_humans.desc: Hikaye kötüsü; konakçı bedeni ele geçirme mekaniği.

artificial_humans.name: Kara Siborgu
artificial_humans.visual: Human with visible metal prosthetics (arm, eye, jaw), black robes with white cloud-like trim (Kara cloak style), glowing tech eye.

artificial_humans.name: Kāma Taşıyıcı (Dış)
artificial_humans.visual: Young human with black diamond-shaped mark on palm/eye, metal horn growth, black markings spreading.

artificial_humans.name: Shinju Klonu
abilities: Copies abilities of beings it absorbs
artificial_humans.behavior: Bağımsız iradeli tanrı-ağacın insan avatarı; aç, meraklı.
artificial_humans.visual: Humanoid with bark-like white/grey skin, branching horns, leaf/vine hair, glowing ringed eyes (Rinne-Sharingan-like), barefoot.
artificial_humans.desc: Boruto Two Blue Vortex dönemi elit düşman.

artificial_humans.name: Pençe İzi Canavarı (Code tipi)
artificial_humans.visual: Grey biomechanical creatures with claw-like faces and mark seals.

artificial_humans.name: Akuta Askeri (Yapay İnsan)
artificial_humans.visual: Masked synthetic human in white bodysuit with stone-like seams.

artificial_humans.name: Fabrikasyon Lider
artificial_humans.visual: Synthetic girl with doll-like face and porcelain sheen.

artificial_humans.name: Gelel Taş Golem Askeri

artificial_humans.first_appears: Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel

artificial_humans.name: Lanetli Mühür Berserkeri
abilities: Stage 2 (grey/dark skin, wings or extra limbs)
artificial_humans.visual: Human whose skin is covered by black flame-pattern markings; stage 2 dark grey/brown skin, hands transform into claws/wings.

artificial_humans.name: Ağaç Klon Yapısı

artificial_humans.visual: Massive armored wooden warrior with kabuto helm, wood grain texture.
